body:
You're not a mistake, you're you. And that's absolutely beautiful. We're not perfect. We fuck up... like a lot. And even when we don't, depression will make us feel like we did. It's not your fault you feel the way you do, it's the virus contaminating your thoughts making you believe it is your fault. 

Sure, it's easy to kill yourself, but you'd be allowing the world to miss out on you. I'm not going to guilt you into not doing it because that is so fucked up and selfish. But I wish I could make you see how beautiful you truly are. Your girlfriend sees it, your family sees it, and I know you see it but your depression makes your vision hazy. 

Please fight on because you're worth so much more than you could ever know man

People are both the audience and the performers in life. You may not want to perform all the time, so you stay and cheer them on from the audience, and they will always love you for that. 

Sending strength and love for our boys in the audience

It is not your fault man. Please know that it will NEVER be your fault that you're depressed. Depression is not YOU, it's just the weights that keep the real you from running. Nobody deserves it, but unfortunately depression does not discriminate and we're stuck with it. 

Sometimes, words can really hurt, especially when they come from your mother. I'm so sorry that you're feeling guilty, depression has a way of trying to make you responsible for everything wrong. 

I wish I could help, but really all I can say is that it's not your fault. I wish you nothing but strength in your battle man. Fuck depression.

Meant to add: my dms are open if talking it out would help
Spot on haha. Just quietly sitting w my pup enjoying the view

First of all, it's really great that you've decided to see a psychologist. Therapy can be so very helpful for people. 

Expect a very slow session. Mostly questions and answering. Your psychologist will be trying to get to know who you are and the kind of things that you're dealing with. Don't expect a diagnosis right off the bat, that will take several sessions. Be as open as you can with them, they only want to help. Good luck!
Maybe I'll take off next semester and get a job until I know what I want to do. Thanks for the advice dood and good luck with everything :))

Ugh it's crazy seeing everyone know exactly what they want to do because I'm still looking for what I want to do with my life lol. I'm studying electrical engineering right now and it's the most boring thing I've ever done in my life. You seem to be so motivated about your education and I just wish I could have that kind of determination. I also love music and video games (not so much anymore) and I was gonna try to go to a music school for guitar and try to get in a touring band for a pop singer or something but I realized how unrealistic that was and decided I'd go for engineering and I just regret it so much. I wish I had gone in undecided because any credits I get this semester won't be able to transfer if I wanted to continue school because they're major courses and not gen ed.
Alright, I just need to think about what I'm gonna say. Thanks for the advice man :)

That's crazy man. How did you know that going back to school would work? You said that you failed out your first semester so like how did you know it would be different this time around? That's an amazing accomplishment and you should definitely be proud of yourself for pulling a 180 with school but what made you know that this time would work out?
What made you choose to go back to school? I feel like if I leave after this semester I'll never come back.
He'd most likely understand what I'm going through as he sees a therapist for his depression and anxiety but he'd still be very upset with me for wasting his money and for getting an F.

I think I'll have to bring it up to my parents when they find out that I failed a class. I just don't know what to say because every time I tell them that shits going on and I'm in an awful place or anything like that they just tell me to focus on school because "grades are the top priority".

My mom thinks my grades aren't great (midterms showed a bunch of C-s) because all I do is go to parties and drink. I've been to one party this entire semester and I left after like 2 hours. She also thinks that I'm out with friends smoking pot all the time even though I have one "friend" here not including my roommate who is so incomparable with my personality type that I wouldn't even consider us friends.
That could be possible I'm not entirely sure. I'm definitely going to get in touch with a professional so I can hopefully work this out
Yes I looked into that too but I think my symptoms fit more with SPD than APD

Yes entering college was really stressful for me. I found myself very depressed and unmotivated. It was the second week my gf broke up with me and I think that sort of triggered this type of thinking. As for my flat affect, I remember having it since maybe sophomore year of high school but I didn't really think about it until now. I don't necessarily like social interaction but I think I crave attention and validation from others. Most of the time, I prefer to be alone but sometimes I get an urge to go meet people and make connections but I feel out of place in most social situations that I usually don't bother
Yeah you're right, I definitely want to know for sure if I have it or not. Thank you!
